description: Creates an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP storage virtual machine (SVM) peer relationship. SVM peering lets two SVMs, in the same file system or in peered file systems, use each other for SnapMirror replication and other applications.

Tag.description: A key-value pair used to tag the SVM peer relationship.

Key.markdownDescription:
The tag key.

---

Required: Yes  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 1  
Maximum Length: 128  
Pattern: ^([\p{L}\p{Z}\p{N}_.:/=+\-@]*)$  
Update requires: No interruption

Value.markdownDescription:
The tag value.

---

Required: Yes  
Type: String  
Maximum Length: 256  
Pattern: ^([\p{L}\p{Z}\p{N}_.:/=+\-@]*)$  
Update requires: No interruption

Tag.markdownDescription:
A key-value pair used to tag the SVM peer relationship.

ResourceARN.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the SVM peer relationship.
ResourceARN.markdownDescription:
The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the SVM peer relationship.

Required: No  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 8  
Maximum Length: 512

Update requires: No interruption
Read only property: Yes
